name: script-v1
idea_origin: Formato line, 27 Oct night: the official JiuwenSwarm agent has bash and code tools and can run a script inside the Skill folder in a headless game (tested with a fake model, zero cost). Split the agent into reader (labels) and script (decision).
hypothesis: DeepSeek loses official games to decision and execution errors (rule contamination, forgetting, hand arithmetic), not only to perception. If DeepSeek only reads each option into sign codes and a script makes every decision with memory across the run, the official score should approach the replica score of a script fed DeepSeek's own labels (~51) instead of 15-42.
predicted_behaviour: DeepSeek calls the advisor on every non-trivial decision, takes its choice, finishes 48 months more often; fewer missed L1 promotions.
refutation: DeepSeek skips the script, mangles the line, or games end as early as before.
